Even after the product was successfully picked up, the refund has turned into a never-ending wait. There have been no clear updates, timelines, or accountability from their end. Requests for clarification, escalation, or supporting evidence behind their decisions are either ignored or inadequately handled. This reflects a concerning lack of transparency in their internal processes.

From a legal standpoint, such practices raise serious concerns. Once a product has been returned and accepted by the company, an unreasonable delay in processing refunds, without valid justification, may amount to deficiency in service. Furthermore, denying or delaying legitimate claims without proper explanation or evidence may fall within the scope of unfair trade practices under applicable consumer protection laws. Businesses are expected to act in good faith, maintain transparency, and ensure timely redressal of customer complaints — failing which they may be held accountable.

It increasingly feels like once the payment is made, retrieving your money becomes unnecessarily complicated. This is not just an inconvenience but a significant breach of trust between the customer and the platform. In today’s competitive e-commerce environment, where other platforms manage to process refunds promptly after pickup, such delays appear arbitrary and unjustified.

Overall, my experience has been disappointing and stressful, especially when reliability is expected from a well-known platform. I would not recommend ordering from AJIO if you are expecting a smooth return process or dependable customer support. Customers should be cautious and aware of their rights when dealing with such situations.
